findings: 200-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ145. The user holds one hand flat and fires a 13-hit barrage of Ki bullets; holding the input increases projectile size and damage. Current evidence identifies long-range projectile behavior and knockback. Exact charge scaling, startup, recovery, and damage curve remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
Unsupported exact frames, hidden gates, probabilities, and patch-independent scaling are not promoted.
Documented acquisition/reward conflicts remain explicit rather than normalized without evidence.
